_comment: cartographer.json - Cartographer Ivo Quill, Lumora's mapmaker (Scripts/talking_vendor_npc.gd on a talking_vendor.tscn; sells Data/vendor_shop.json 'lumora_cartographer'). Placeholder name. ALL LINES ARE DRAFTS for the user to change.
greeting: A traveller without a map is just lost with extra steps. Looking to learn?
Parchment, charcoal, a steady hand. The rest you earn with your feet.
Maps! Well. The makings of maps. Nobody sells a good map; you walk one.
shop_intro: The scroll teaches you the craft. Parchment and charcoal carry the map. A compass tells you where you stand on it.
ambient: Charcoal and parchment! Chart the dunes yourself, and never trust a map you didn't walk!
The Outskirts change every season. A map is only as good as the last pair of boots that crossed it.
Compasses! The needle never lies, even when the sand does.
secret: There are places in the Plateaus that don't want to be drawn. The charcoal smudges there. Every time.
The Wardens' maps stop at the burial mounds. Mine don't. Mine just get quieter.

lines: Hail. Maps, or the making of them?
Learn the craft from my scroll, carry parchment and charcoal, and walk. The map draws itself behind you, as good as your skill. Press M to look at it.
